title: Issuance of POFMA Correction Direction for Online Commentaries on Compensation of Temasek Holdings CEO
what_it_is: Issuance of POFMA Correction Direction for Online Commentaries on Compensation of Temasek Holdings CEO

sections.label: TOC judicial review application
sections.summary: TOC filed a High Court application for judicial review of the correction direction, raising public interest grounds under POFMA, so the question is not answered.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: On 29 April 2020, The Online Citizen, or TOC, filed an application to the High Court seeking judicial review of the decision to issue the correction direction.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: One of the issues that TOC has raised before the Court relates to the public interest grounds under the Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act or POFMA.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As this issue is now before the Court, given the specific circumstances of this case, it is not appropriate to answer this question.

sections.label: Court to decide public trust
sections.summary: The judicial review puts the public interest question before the Court, which will decide whether the POFMA test was met.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: He asked whether the POFMA directive is going to meet the requirement of public trust.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, the question really is this: the issue that has now been put in play by the application for judicial review is whether there is a question of public interest and that is before the Court.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Court is an independent tribunal that will make that decision.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: At the end of the day, insofar as this specific question of public trust is involved, the Court will decide on that.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The public trust will be upheld because the public will know when the Court decides on this issue, whether or not the test under POFMA was met.
